Are you passionate about driving innovation through technical excellence and ensuring that products meet compliance standards? Are you capable of translating grid connection compliance standards into applicable requirements, specification and implementation to shape the future of power management? If so, you could be the perfect fit for this exciting role at DEIF A/S!

At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that Improve Tomorrow.

About the Job

As an Embedded SW Developer, you’ll be an integral part of DEIF’s skilled embedded SW Team focussing on measurement and protection. Your primary focus will be ensuring our products not only meet various grid connection standards but also exceed market requirements. You will play a key role building our new products from collaborating on specifications through implementation to quality assurance though a proper continuous integration enabled pipeline. Additionally, you will help ensure expansions of functionality in existing products and maintaining our solutions towards quality and security needs.

Working tasks & responsibilities

• Develop SW within the embedded SW domain for our diverse products.

• Ensure pipeline integration and continuous integration.

• Documenting functionality and setup methods, while supporting technical documentation.

• Maintenance and quality assurance of the developed SW.

• Improve structure of frameworks and apply/improve platform structure across products.

In addition to an exciting job full of challenging tasks, you will experience a professional work environment where collaboration, interdependence, and co-determination are watchwords. DEIF will provide great opportunities to grow plus different benefits and perks supporting your health and well-being.

What you’ll bring

• An engineering degree involving SW heavy engineering, preferably within electrical engineering or a similar field.

• Adapt SW developer skills in HW near code (C, C++)

• Solid experience in SW engineering principes like SOLID additionally to creational, structural and behavioural design patterns.

• Well versed and varied experience with SW engineering tools.

• Advanced communication skills in English and preferably also in Danish

• Experience within three phase power systems is a highly desired bonus.

You are thorough, detail-oriented, and thrive in managing complex challenges. Your problem-solving abilities and clear communication make you a trusted team player and decision-maker. Above all, you’re courageous in tackling challenges and confident in your ability to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Interviews for this role are expected to take place as suitable applicants are screened, or a suitable candidate is found.

Why join DEIF?

At DEIF A/S, you’ll be part of a family-owned company with strong values and a culture built on trust, openness, and collaboration. You’ll experience a professional and highly engaged working environment, where we’re curious on each other’s perspectives and encourage respectful, honest dialogue that drives growth. Our strength lies in responsibility, teamwork, and the courage to innovate – that’s what drives us forward.

In addition to a role filled with exciting challenges, we offer you:

• Flexible work arrangements, including home office days and access to our satellite office in Silkeborg

• The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in state-of-the-art facilities

• On-the-job training and knowledge sharing with skilled employees

• In-house canteen and physiotherapist at our headquarters

• Fitness breaks, social events, and much more supporting your wellbeing.

Want to know more about working at DEIF? Visit our career page today!

Description

Are you passionate about rare endocrine diseases and advancing medical innovation? Do you have experience within Medical Affairs and enjoy translating science into meaningful impact for patients and healthcare professionals?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Global Medical Scientist.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Global Medical Scientist to join our Global Medical Affairs organization. In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert within rare endocrinology and support the development and execution of global medical strategies across Ascendis Pharma’s growing portfolio. You will work closely with colleagues across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Commercial, Market Access, and local affiliate teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of global initiatives.

You will be joining the Global Medical Office and report directly to the Senior Global Director, Global Medical Office. The position is based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support the development and execution of global medical strategies, medical narratives, and strategic imperatives across the Ascendis Pharma portfolio.

• Generate and communicate medical insights related to disease areas, treatment landscapes, competitive developments, and unmet patient needs.

• Support global medical education initiatives, congress activities, advisory boards, and engagement with key external stakeholders, including KOLs, patient advocacy groups, and medical societies.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support evidence generation activities, including real-world evidence, observational studies, and Phase IV programs.

• Partner closely with local medical teams to ensure alignment and execution of global medical strategies and tactics.

Qualifications and Skills

You hold an advanced scientific degree such as MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent, and have at least 5 years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, preferably in Medical Affairs.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong experience interpreting, communicating, and applying clinical data in a scientific and strategic context.

• Experience working within endocrinology, rare diseases, or other specialized therapeutic areas.

• Solid understanding of Medical Affairs, drug development processes, and global pharmaceutical compliance requirements.

• Proven ability to build trusted partnerships and work effectively in a complex global matrix organization.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both internal and external stakeholders.

Key competencies

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be scientifically curious, collaborative, and able to translate complex medical information into actionable insights. You are proactive, relationship-oriented, and comfortable navigating a dynamic international environment.

Travel: Approximately 20% international travel.

Office: Copenhagen, Denmark or the US, Princeton

Apply now

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform – applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Senior Medical Director Anette Arnberg at aag@ascendispharma.com or Senior Medical Director Annette Hommelgaard at aho@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

As the summer holiday period approaches, you may experience a longer response time than usual. We truly appreciate your patience and thank you for your understanding. We look forward to reviewing your application as soon as possible.

Are you a skilled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer with experience across the full AI solution lifecycle, from model development and training to deployment and operation at scale? Do you enjoy combining deep technical expertise with practical, business-focused solutions that drive innovation and improve processes? If so, you could be our next Senior AI Engineer!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI at JYSK by helping accelerate AI adoption across the organization. As part of a high-performing, agile AI Engineering team, you’ll contribute to our strategic ambition of integrating AI into business processes across the company. If you’re passionate about technical innovation and enjoy solving real-world business challenges with AI, we’d love to hear from you!

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A dynamic workplace in an international company focused on growth, innovation, and continuous development.

• A collaborative, open-minded environment with opportunities to engage across all organisational levels.

• A flexible work-from-home policy that supports a healthy work-life balance.

• Attractive employee benefits, including staff discounts across the Lars Larsen Group and a variety of social events throughout the year.

• Access to internal training, courses, and learning opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

• A welcoming and supportive culture, complemented by a comprehensive onboarding programme to help you succeed from day one.

• A low-politics, low-ego culture where collaboration, ownership, and high standards are valued.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing AI solutions that drive innovation, enable data-driven decision-making, improve operations, and enhance customer experiences. You will bridge software engineering and machine learning, focusing on model experimentation, deployment, and integration to create scalable, efficient, and reusable solutions.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Develop and scale end-to-end AI applications and MLOps pipelines using your deep software engineering background.

• Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI agent systems, from orchestration and tool integration to production deployment and monitoring.

• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, embedding workflows, and semantic search solutions where appropriate.

• Research, experiment with, and develop classical and state-of-the-art AI models across NLP, Computer Vision, Deep Generative Models, Graph Neural Networks, and Reinforcement Learning to improve and optimize JYSK’s business processes.

• Collaborate closely with data, AI, and platform engineers on complex projects to integrate cutting-edge models into impactful AI products.

• Managing AI workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ensure optimal performance and resource efficiency.

• Working with architects to refine AI solution design and contributing to solution planning phases.

• Supporting end-users of AI solutions with a "you build it, you own it" mindset.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Holds a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. A PhD is considered an advantage.

• Has 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, designing and implementing AI solutions at scale using Python.

• Has a strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, with experience spanning both discriminative and generative models applied to structured data, natural language, and vision.

• Has experience developing, deploying, operating, and monitoring AI models in production at scale, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (or equivalent experience with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work with GCP).

• Has hands-on experience in one of the following areas: Building AI agents at scale integrated with advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Pre-training, fine-tuning, or post-training large language models (LLMs). Developing and deploying state-of-the-art generative AI solutions for computer vision in real-world environments.

• Works independently on complex technical challenges while collaborating effectively with stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes.

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader AI Engineering, Florencio Paucar at +45 27794325.

Send us a brief application with your CV by clicking “Apply”. We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

ABOUT US

We believe that our employees are key to our success going from one store in 1979 to more than 3,400 stores worldwide today. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing within JYSK, and we also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in delegation and freedom with responsibility.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

As a Project Manager Intern at Pangaea Youth Network (PYN), you will play a crucial role in planning, executing, and overseeing various youth-led projects. You will collaborate with our dynamic team to ensure that our initiatives are delivered on time and within scope. This position offers an opportunity to develop your project management skills while working on exciting Erasmus+ programs and events focused on youth participation and intercultural learning.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Assist in the planning and implementation of youth projects and activities.

• 
Coordinate with team members and stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration.

• 
Monitor project progress and report on outcomes.

• 
Contribute to the evaluation and improvement of project activities.

Internship Benefits:

• 
Flexible internship length tailored to your availability.

• 
Exciting and supportive community of like-minded individuals.

• 
Cosy office space located in Horsens, Denmark.

• 
Exclusive access to Erasmus+ projects (youth exchanges and training courses) where you can learn new skills and network with international participants. For Erasmus+ training courses and youth exchanges abroad (5-10 days): travel, food, and accommodation costs are covered by the EU funds.

• 
Opportunities for personal and professional development through workshops and training sessions.

• 
Gain hands-on experience in project management and a deeper understanding of international collaboration.

Note: While we are unable to provide monetary support, we offer a wealth of non-monetary benefits that will enhance your skills and experience in the field of youth engagement.

Questions? Write us at contact@pangaeayouth.org. Please make sure you are logged in to apply.

Internship Landscape Architect / Urban Planner

Aarhus/Aalborg/Copenhagen

Internship Duration: 2 February 2027 to 25 June 2027

Do you want to work for an Architecture firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be a Landscape Architect/Urban Planner? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree within Urban/Landscape Architecture field or similar.

• Have good problem-solving skills

• Be a creative and technical thinker

• Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

• Sustainability, materials & reuse

• BIM, Revit, design & sketching

• Client consultancy & tendering

• Restoration & building preservation

• Competitions & visualizations

• Descriptions & quality assurance

• Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

**A place to work and so much more

**At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

**Got more questions

**

Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

**Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key.

**We focus on creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equal opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are considered valuable. We also take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes when we put together teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

NOTE

Kindly submit your CV, Cover Letter, and Portfolio. As only two attachment fields are available on the application page, please combine files where needed and upload them accordingly.

We only accept applications from active students who have not already completed an internship within their studies.

The Role

Our Purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

You will be leading a group of engineers while directly contributing to the successful outcomes of the team by supporting excellent engineering practices, working on the team’s roadmap and strategy and enabling rapid delivery of high quality software. You will be responsible for supporting your direct reports in becoming awesome Plandayers, empowering them to deliver high-quality software to customers and fostering the growth of a world-class engineering culture.

You’ll maintain a working environment in which your team can do their best work predictably and sustainably. You’ll make sure the team has all the information they need and the right feedback loops in place to discover and deliver valuable, usable, and buildable outcomes. You’ll monitor and look to support the operational health of your team and products, aiming for resilience.

You will support your team to hone their engineering skills and grow as individuals in order to meet the capabilities required for the team. Your focus will be on driving engineering initiatives and ensuring the team makes progress towards their goals.

What you’ll do

Leadership, People & Culture

• 
Lead, develop and grow a high performing team through coaching, mentoring and setting a clear direction by connecting the work they do to the Planday Engineering and Product strategic objectives.

• 
Support each member of your team to identify, grow and develop engineering capabilities and career.

• 
Work closely together with the product manager and product designer in your team, forming the trio that enables a both autonomous and empowered team.

• 
Create a culture of psychological safety and inclusion. Ensure the health of your team is monitored, that all members of your team are empowered to raise ideas and concerns, and that everyone contributes to improvements in how the team works together.

• 
Driving continuous improvement through reviewing, developing and implementing best practice ways of working.

• 
Help to cultivate a fun, appreciative, rewarding, innovative and results-driven culture that lives and breathes our Planday values.

• 
Attract, recruit and retain capable individuals, building on and complementing the diversity of teams.

Engineering & Delivery

• 
Ensure your team's delivery pipeline is flowing at a predictable and sustainable pace, raising and addressing blockers as appropriate.

• 
Take part in our continuous exploration and implementation of AI tooling in our development practices.

• 
You come with a strong technical background and are able to be hands-on in the team and take part in the engineering work.

• 
Ensure accurate, fit for purpose and sustainable delivery systems exist in your team. You'll be responsible for your team providing informed estimates, delivery forecasting, capacity planning, and associated reporting.

• 
Understand and advocate Engineering and Security Standards. Working as part of a leadership group, you’ll facilitate an engineering approach that is compliant to these standards and fosters sustainably excellent engineering.

• 
Working with your peers in Product and your team, assist in the development roadmaps and plans which effectively and efficiently deliver business outcomes.

• 
Stay up-to-date with emerging practices, technologies and frameworks.

• 
Work with engineers and customer facing teams to troubleshoot and resolve production issues, where appropriate.

• 
Coach and enable your team toward effective and efficient delivery.

Success looks like

• 
Empower & develop your team: Ensure everyone understands how their work drives Planday's success, is challenged to grow, and receives regular, timely feedback with clear development paths.

• 
Deliver high-quality software: Maintain a predictable pace of delivery that meets customer needs, complies with engineering standards, and communicates technical risks and scope expectations clearly.

• 
AI as a multiplier: You actively explore and adopt AI-assisted development tools and practices, enabling your team to work smarter, reduce repetitive effort, and push the boundaries of what a team can deliver.

• 
Foster a collaborative culture: Enable participation in communities, cross-team collaboration, and knowledge sharing both within and outside the team, modeling inclusion and continuous improvement.

• 
Remove barriers: Understand what drives your team's best work, actively clear blockers, and ensure operational hygiene (leave, expenses, processes) is handled smoothly.

What you’ll bring with you

• 
7+ years of experience in software engineering, with demonstrated experience leading or mentoring engineering teams in a SaaS environment.

• 
Deep technical expertise in at least one core language ideally the backend (C#, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript) and knowledge of modern front-end frameworks (React or Angular).

• 
Proven track record working with microservices architectures, cloud infrastructure (AWS/CDN), and robust public/private APIs.

• 
Experience with third-party software integrations (e.g., Payroll, HR, POS systems) and working within certified security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC2).

• 
Pragmatic, "hands-on" technical leadership balance—equally comfortable diving into architectural discussions, reviewing code, or guiding high-level product strategy.

• 
Strong communication skills with an ability to bridge technical requirements with business goals.

What we value

This position description is intended merely as a guideline of the responsibilities involved in the position. The employee is expected to perform any other duties as reasonably required by their Manager.

Are you a university student with strong programming skills in R and LaTeX? Do you want to gain hands-on experience supporting drug development in a leading pharmaceutical company?

Ascendis Pharma is looking for a Student Assistant to join our Pharmacometrics department in Hellerup.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Student Assistant to join our team. As a member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in supporting the maintenance and development of our pharmacometrics modelling platform, contributing to analyses used in drug development.

You will be joining the Pharmacometrics Department and be based in Hellerup. You will join a collaborative team of experienced pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and colleagues with recent experience as student helpers. You will gain hands-on experience working on real-world drug development challenges.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining and developing R and LaTeX templates

• Supporting QC of regulatory documents and calculations

Qualifications and skills

You are currently enrolled and pursuing an academic degree. Ideally studying statistics, mathematics, data science, bioinformatics, biomedicine, pharmacy or similar.

Furthermore, you have:

• Completed at least 2 years of university studies and has at least 2 years remaining, studying

• Understand object-oriented programming and clinical time-series data

• Has strong programming skills in R (e.g., dplyr, tidyverse) and preferably experience with LaTeX (e.g., knitr, hyperref or cleveref)

• Is detail-oriented with a scientific mindset, and enjoys writing efficient and structured code (e.g., functions, packages, ggplot)

It is an advantage if you:

• Have experience with Git

• Have an interest in pharmacometrics and drug development

• Have experience with non-linear fixed effects modeling (NONMEM) and differential equations

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be service-minded and would like to work in a diverse team with many different ongoing tasks

Hours: approx.4-8 hours per week. We want you to be able to balance your studies and work responsibilities and therefore offer flexibility during exam periods.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup (presence in the office is expected)

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

If you would like to learn more, please contact Kristin C. Petri, Sr. Director, Head of Pharmacometrics (mailto: ).

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation.  Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed.  If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistants - Customer Experience Projects & Innovation
jobs.description:
Want to work at the intersection of customer experience, digital solutions and commercial innovation?

This is your chance to be part of shaping how we create value for users and healthcare professionals — in a global MedTech company.

We are looking for two student assistants to join our Customer Experience organization at HQ in Humlebæk. One of our recent student assistants has just transitioned into a full-time role after two years in the team — and we are now looking for new talent to continue building the function.

In Customer Experience, we work to deliver superior customer experiences and be the trusted partner for our users/patients and healthcare professionals (e.g. nurses).

Join Customer Experience and collaborate across four global teams

You will be part of a newly established Customer Experience organization, working across four teams: User Experience, HCP Experience, Service Operational Excellence, and Digital Marketing & Demand Generation.

Together, we define, develop and implement the future customer experience — from understanding user needs and shaping digital journeys to creating content and enabling scalable solutions across markets. In this role, you will get hands-on experience working across all four teams and learn how different parts of a global commercial organization come together.

Build your commercial understanding and competencies

As a Student Assistant, you will work approx. 15–20 hours per week and support across the department — gaining exposure to a broad range of topics by collaborating across multiple teams, which is a unique opportunity in a student role. You will refer to a manager who will help you prioritize and develop in the role.

Tasks will vary, but are likely to include:

•    Supporting Customer Experience projects across user experience, HCP experience, service operations and digital marketing

•    Contributing to user research, customer insights and digital initiatives

•    Coordinating stakeholder input and helping drive activities across teams and markets

•    Assisting with PowerPoint preparation, project coordination and stakeholder input

•    Supporting the team with administrative and ad hoc tasks

A proactive student who enjoys creating impact and turning ideas into action

You are curious and motivated by creating impact. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating with different stakeholders and helping move initiatives forward. You are not afraid to challenge existing thinking, explore new ideas and turn opportunities into action.

We imagine that you:

•    Are currently studying a bachelor’s or master’s degree within business, marketing, digital, innovation or similar

•    Enjoy working across different teams, topics and problem types

•    Are proactive, pragmatic and motivated by getting things done

•    Have strong PowerPoint skills

•    Are fluent in English, written and spoken

•    Bring a commercial mindset and enjoy connecting the dots across disciplines

•    Enjoy working with people and building relationships across functions and markets

•    Experience with content platforms, Excel or design tools is a plus, but not a requirement

What we offer

You will become part of a global, purpose-driven organization with strong ambitions for Customer Experience. You will gain hands-on experience working across projects, teams and disciplines — and contribute to work that makes a real difference for users and healthcare professionals.

You will also have the opportunity to be part of Coloplast Young Professionals, a community where students and early-career colleagues connect, network and participate in both professional and social events across the organization.

Working in Humlebæk might feel far from your studies (e.g. in Copenhagen), but Coloplast offers a shuttle bus between the train station and the office. As you get into the role and become more confident in your tasks, you will also have flexibility to work from home when needed — especially during busy periods like exams.

Ready to apply?

If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply today. For more information about the role, feel free to reach out to Signe Bunke at dksbun@coloplast.com.

We will review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to submit yours. This position will remain open until the right candidate has been found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

An analytical student who enjoys creating structure and quality

Ready to apply?

Job Description

Do you want to take senior hands-on technical ownership of how mission-critical data centers are designed, expanded, and handed over for operation?

GlobalConnect is expanding data center capacity across the Nordics and Northern Europe. To support this growth, we are strengthening our Large Projects organization with a Data Center Designer based in Taastrup.

This is a senior specialist role at our highest specialist level. You will act as a technical authority across large data center projects, influence design direction, challenge key technical decisions, and help shape more consistent ways of working across countries.

The role is a hands-on role. You will work directly with layouts, power and cooling concepts, system architecture, technical documentation, supplier designs, commissioning readiness, and operational handover. This is not a technician or installation role, but you should enjoy getting close to the technical solution and being present in the data center environment.

What you need to succeed

• Hands on experience with data center infrastructure or other mission-critical environments, such as energy, pharma, industrial facilities, or similar

• Strong understanding of cooling systems and power infrastructure in mission-critical environments

• Proven hands-on experience with alarm and monitoring systems, including system architecture and integration with critical infrastructure such as power, cooling, and security

• Ability to interpret, review, and challenge engineering drawings, technical documentation, specifications, supplier designs, and system architecture choices

• Fluent English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage

About the role and the team

You will join a small, senior, and specialized team working across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Germany. The team works closely across borders and is building a more consistent pan-Nordic approach to data center design, expansion, and operational readiness.

In Denmark, this role closes an important capability gap. You will bring deep technical design expertise into a setup that already has strong project management capability. You will work closely with Project Managers, Sales, Procurement, external consultants, vendors, customers, and Operations.

A key part of the role is to act as a trusted technical advisor. You will help translate customer needs into technically sound solutions, challenge assumptions when needed, and ensure that design choices support long-term reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.

What you’ll be working on

• Act as technical authority within large data center projects, from early concept through commissioning, acceptance, and handover

• Own and challenge system-level design decisions across power, cooling, controls, alarm and monitoring systems, security, and building interfaces

• Review layouts, airflow concepts, cooling capacity assumptions, power distribution principles, single-line diagrams, and supplier designs

• Develop and review technical requirements, specifications, scopes of supply, risk assessments, and design documentation

• Support FATs, site inspections, commissioning activities, acceptance testing, and operational handover

• Strengthen standardisation, repeatable technical solutions, and design quality across projects and countries

Who we are looking for

You are a senior mechanical technical specialist who enjoys working with complex systems, high expectations, and decisions that have long-term operational impact.

You are confident in your technical judgement and comfortable challenging designs, suppliers, consultants, customers, and internal stakeholders when the solution needs to be improved. You can explain complex technical choices clearly and help others understand the trade-offs between reliability, cost, schedule, scalability, and operational readiness.

You enjoy working close to the physical technical solution. You are comfortable reviewing drawings, questioning assumptions, calculating capacity, discussing design alternatives, and explaining why a solution will work in practice.

To succeed in this role, you should also be motivated by building trust across teams. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Projects, Operations, vendors, and customers, especially where expectations, technical reality, and operational needs must be aligned.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Our recruitment process

• Talent Acquisition Screen

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• Case interview with Hiring Manager and peer/stakeholder

• Final alignment meeting

• References

Practical information

This role is based in Taastrup, Denmark, and requires strong on-site presence in the data center environment. We are only open to applicants already based in Denmark

Due to security clearance requirements, you must be able to document that you have lived and worked in an EU or NATO country for the past 7 years and we are not able to offer work visa support or sponsorship for this role

At GlobalConnect, you will play a key role in building and safeguarding critical digital infrastructure that society depends on every day. You will have real technical influence, work on complex data center projects, and help shape how we design and deliver reliable infrastructure across multiple countries.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

Design the systems that guide satellites in orbit for new ambitious missions

We are seeking an experienced AOCS/GNC Engineer to design, develop, and validate attitude determination, orbit control, and autonomous navigation solutions for small satellite missions. In this role, you will develop guidance and control strategies across diverse and demanding mission profiles — from VLEO drag-dominated regimes to deep-space trajectories and asteroid proximity operations.

You will join our Advanced Missions global team, developing next-generation AOCS/GNC concepts while collaborating closely with GomSpace's established AOCS team in Aalborg — who built and flew the AOCS for the Juventas CubeSat on ESA's Hera mission and are currently developing full 6-DoF GNC for the Llevant (RAMSES) asteroid rendezvous mission.

**

Your Role**

As AOCS/GNC Engineer, you will own the attitude and orbit control design for advanced mission proposals — from requirements definition and algorithm design through high-fidelity simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design and implement AOCS/GNC algorithms for attitude determination, control, and autonomous navigation across diverse mission profiles.

• Develop guidance and orbit-control strategies tailored to SSA, VLEO drag-dominated regimes, and deep-space trajectories.

• Model and simulate spacecraft dynamics, environmental disturbances, and sensor/actuator performance for mission-specific scenarios.

• Validate algorithms through high-fidelity simulations, Monte-Carlo analyses, and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

• Collaborate with systems, propulsion, and mission design teams to define control requirements and ensure end-to-end stability and performance.

**

What Success Looks Like**

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace's AOCS product portfolio (GSW-600 reaction wheels, Auriga/Twinkle star trackers, STIM300 IMU, AOCS Flightcore software).

• Delivering your first AOCS sizing and mode analysis for a mission proposal and setting up a reusable MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment.

• Establishing working relationships with the Aalborg AOCS team and communicating AOCS trade-offs clearly to non-AOCS stakeholders.

Over time, you will be recognised for owning end-to-end AOCS/GNC design for advanced mission proposals, developing and maintaining GNC strategies across multiple mission regimes, and achieving successful Monte-Carlo validation campaigns that demonstrate algorithm robustness.

**

What You Bring**

You are an AOCS/GNC specialist with deep analytical rigour and a passion for solving complex spacecraft dynamics and control challenges across unconventional mission profiles.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Control Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. A PhD focused on GNC, spacecraft dynamics, or autonomous navigation is a strong plus.

• 3–5+ years of experience in AOCS/GNC algorithm design, simulation, and validation for spacecraft missions.

• Experience with attitude determination (gyro-stellar estimators, EKF/UKF), 3-axis control (sliding mode, PD/PID, LQR), and momentum management.

• Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink for spacecraft dynamics modelling and Monte-Carlo analysis.

• Experience with C/C++ implementation of flight algorithms and familiarity with AOCS sensors and actuators (star trackers, IMUs, reaction wheels, magnetorquers, RCS thrusters).

• Exposure to ESA/ECSS project lifecycle and AOCS design reviews (PDR, CDR) is highly valued.

**

Who You Are**

You combine deep mathematical rigour with creative engineering intuition. You are energised by the challenge of designing control solutions for missions that push the boundaries of what nanosatellites can do.

You are known for:

• Analytical depth — AOCS/GNC demands mathematical precision, and you deliver it.

• Creative problem solving — developing novel control strategies for unconventional mission profiles.

• Collaborative communication — translating complex dynamics and control concepts into clear requirements for systems and propulsion teams.

• Self-driven initiative — comfortable with ambiguity in early-phase mission design.

• Execution discipline – ensuring commitments are met in demanding environments.

• Customer focus – ensuring focus on customer’s success.

• True leadership — taking ownership of your domain and driving technical excellence.

**

Why Join Us**

You will play a key role in shaping future space missions at their most decisive stage. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with leading institutional customers, influence mission architectures from the start, and contribute to programs with long-term strategic impact.

**

Join our mission**

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: Gaetano Livornese, Department Manager. E-mail: gali@gomspace.com

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6 in Aalborg, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

We kindly draw your attention to the fact that we do not receive applications and resumes via e-mail or by personal appearance. This is to protect and show consideration for your personal information. Apply for the job by following the link below.

**

About GomSpace**

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Learn more on www.gomspace.com

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

jobs.description:
The Company

COWI is a leading international consultancy within engineering, architecture, energy, and the environment. In close collaboration with clients, COWI co-creates innovative and sustainable solutions that enhance quality of life for current and future generations. With a primary presence in Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, North America, and India, COWI employs approximately 7,500 professionals who bring expertise across a wide range of disciplines.

If you are curious to learn more, we invite you to explore some of COWI’s featured projects at www.cowi.com or view their global portfolio at: Projects around the world (cowi.com)

On behalf of COWI, Best Talent is now seeking an Associate Project Director.

The organisation & the Team

COWI’s Building & Industry Executing Unit in Denmark, consists of approximately 1050 professionals and specialists across building related disciplines.

Within this framework, you will be part of a dedicated Multidisciplinary Project Management team in Lyngby, consisting of approximately 38 committed colleagues. This structure ensures a strong, supportive, and highly professional environment focused on excellence in project delivery.

As part of this strong professional community, you will work alongside dedicated, talented, and ambitious colleagues who are strongly committed to excellence in project leadership and management. Moreover, you will have the opportunity to realize your full potential within an inclusive and supportive professional environment.

Associate Project Director

Exiting Multidisciplinary Building Projects – From Design to Execution

• Strong focus on clients and project delivery

• Thrive in a collaborative and supportive culture

• Shape your own professional development

• Contribute to a more sustainable and livable world

The Challenge

As Associated Project Director for construction projects in Denmark, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management of building projects—from initial planning through to execution. Your role will encompass quality assurance, budget control, contractual and financial oversight, as well as the coordination of timelines and resources.

You will also act as the key liaison with clients and collaborate closely with stakeholders such as public authorities, contractors, and design partners.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading new construction and renovation projects from concept to completion

• Participating in large-scale projects as part of a broader project management team

• Managing complex stakeholder environments, clients, authorities, contractors, and design partners

• Maintain close collaboration with clients to ensure their needs and expectations are consistently met

• Overseeing project scope, schedule, risks, and cost management

• Ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and sustainability across all project stages

• Driving cross-disciplinary collaboration across COWI’s teams and geographies

• Contributing to the professional development of project team members

Why join COWI?

At COWI, your work contributes to shaping a sustainable and liveable world. By combining deep knowledge, curiosity, and courage, COWI develops solutions that address today’s challenges and enable a better tomorrow. COWI has committed to phasing out fossil-based projects and aspires for 100% of its revenue to stem from sustainability-focused initiatives.

COWI values diversity, continuous development, and a sense of belonging. They foster a supportive and enjoyable workplace, knowing that a healthy work-life balance enhances performance both professionally and personally. You will report to the Vice President of the group and be offered a competitive compensation package, aligned with your experience and qualifications.

Your profile & Talent:

You are an experienced Multidisciplinary Project Manager who thrives in collaboration with colleagues, partners, and clients. You foster strong relationships through integrity, accountability, and a proactive mindset. Your background has equipped you to confidently lead medium- to large-scale design projects.

Qualifications and key competencies:

• A relevant academic background in civil engineering, architecture, or a related discipline

• Professional experience in Denmark, with in-depth knowledge of all phases of the Danish building project lifecycle

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex project environments

• A proactive and structured approach to work, with keen attention to detail

• A self-motivated and inspiring personality that promotes teamwork and positive dynamics

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written

Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is a core value at COWI, and inclusion is a strategic priority. The company is committed to fostering a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities for growth. Leaders at COWI are expected to model inclusive behaviour and embrace diverse perspectives as a strength in team formation and decision-making processes. These commitments are not only embedded in COWI’s values—they are part of what the company believes is the right thing to do.

Application

Best Talent is managing the recruitment process and will treat all applications with strict confidentiality.

Please send your application in English, marked “1920/Associated Project Director, COWI”, to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible due to the urgency of this position. For more information about Best Talent, please visit www.besttalent.dk.

Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

Ready to build, not just support?

Are you a curious and driven student who loves structure, details and making things work better? Do you want real responsibility, broad HR exposure, and the chance to help build HR processes in a global industrial company with more than 125 years of history?

At DISA Industries, part of the Norican Group, we are looking for a Student Assistant in HR who is ready to take ownership, ask questions, and help us strengthen and develop our HR foundation.

This is not a “fetch‑and‑file” student job. This is a role where you’ll learn, contribute, and grow.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

• A small, dynamic HR setup – locally it will be you and the HR Business Partner, working closely together with real responsibility and short decision paths

• Hands‑on HR from day one – you’ll help build, structure and improve HR processes rather than just support existing ones

• Strong global backing – while the local team is small, we are part of a larger global HR team across the Norican Group

• A business in motion – DISA combines more than a century of industrial heritage with ongoing change, digitalisation and development

• A pragmatic, people‑focused environment where things get done through trust, collaboration and ownership

This role is ideal for you, if you thrive in a setting where you get responsibility, variety and ample of opportunities to learn. At DISA, many people stay for a long time – not because they have to, but because they want to.

Who You Are

You’re about to finish your bachelor’s degree or currently studying your master’s, for example cand.merc.psyk, cand.soc.hrm or a similar relevant programme, and you’re ready to put theory into practice.

You are:

• Proactive, driven and curious, with a strong sense of ownership

• Genuinely interested in HR processes, people data and organisational structures

• Structured, detail‑oriented and analytical. You like things to be correct and well‑organised

• Comfortable working independently and following tasks through from start to finish

• Motivated by learning and by being part of building something, not just maintaining it

Most importantly: you enjoy learning, improving things, are curious by heart and enjoy being part of a small dynamic team.

What We Offer

• A student job with substance, responsibility and learning

• Insight into HR in a global industrial organisation

• A chance to build skills that matter for your future career

• A welcoming, down‑to‑earth culture with high professionalism

This role is a strong match if you’re looking for a student job where you learn by doing, take responsibility, and build a solid foundation for a future HR career. You bring the curiosity and drive, and we will help develop your skillset.

What You’ll Do

Your tasks will evolve as you grow in the role, but will include a mix of operational HR work, such as:

• Supporting and developing core HR processes across the employee lifecycle

• Preparing and maintaining employment contracts, amendments and HR documentation for payroll

• Supporting the implementation and use of an HRIS, including data structure, quality and processes

• Ensuring HR data accuracy and well‑structured documentation

• Contributing to process design, standardisation and improvement

• Preparing analyses, overviews and HR material for local and global use

• Acting as a trusted HR support for employees and managers in daily matters

You’ll work closely with the HR Business Partner and gain insight into both local HR responsibility and global HR ways of working within Norican.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

Ready to learn more and ready to apply?

We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you want to build HR skills, take ownership, and be part of a company where people and values truly matter – we’d love to hear from you.

About Norican

NORICAN. Shaping Industry.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

DISA

DISA design, build and support premium green sand moulding and cashing machines for the ferrous and non-ferrous foundry industries. For 125 years they have delivered machines that last for decades, and they are highly respected by customers and peers for excellent levels of quality and service. DISA machines keep customers producing relentlessly to the very highest standards. And they empower foundry productivity with a lifetime of efficient and a lower cost per casting.

Tembi is building the intelligence layer for European e-commerce.

We monitor more than 1 million online retailers across Europe and transform billions of datapoints into market intelligence that helps logistics providers, retailers and technology companies understand where the market is moving before their competitors do.

The next generation of market intelligence will not be built on static reports and dashboards. It will be built on continuously evolving data pipelines, AI-assisted enrichment, and systems capable of turning fragmented web signals into trusted commercial insight at scale.

We are at a rare moment in the company’s journey:

the market opportunity is large, our product is gaining traction across Europe, and the engineering team is still small enough that great engineers leave fingerprints on everything they build.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong foundations in Python, infrastructure, data engineering and large-scale data systems to help us build the core of that platform.

The team you’ll join

You will join a tight-knit engineering team of software engineers and data engineers working closely together to evolve our Market Intelligence platform.

We are around 20 colleagues today, with customers across Europe and a multicultural office in central Copenhagen.

We work with flat hierarchies, short decision paths and high ownership. Engineers at Tembi work closely with Product, Customer Success and customers themselves to understand real problems and ship solutions that create value quickly.

This is not an environment where engineers disappear into narrow silos or spend months building in isolation. We value pragmatic execution, strong collaboration and people who enjoy solving difficult problems head-on.

Current technology environment

Our platform and data infrastructure currently includes technologies such as:

• 
Python

• 
Azure

• 
MySQL

• 
Databricks

• 
Distributed scraping infrastructure

• 
Large-scale data processing pipelines

• 
CI/CD automation

• 
TypeScript services and tooling

We continuously evolve our architecture as we expand into new markets, products and AI-driven capabilities.

What you’ll do

• 
Evolve and maintain our scraping engine while expanding into new European markets and adapting to an increasingly dynamic and competitive web landscape.

• 
Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and backend services powering Tembi’s market intelligence platform.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo processes thousands of hours of sports video daily, powering AI analysis for teams from grassroots to professional levels. The infrastructure you build will directly enable coaches and athletes worldwide to analyze, train, and compete better.

We're building KickOff, our next-generation GitOps platform. You'll join during a pivotal moment: we're actively migrating services to KickOff, establishing new platform patterns and enabling 100+ engineers to ship faster and more reliably. We also maintain separate on-premises Kubernetes clusters running model training and video processing workloads.

This isn't a "keep the lights on" role. You'll shape platform architecture, drive technical decisions, and directly impact engineering velocity across both cloud and on-prem environments.

What You Will Do

You'll join the platform engineering team that owns these areas together. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities.

• Evolve KickOff (our GitOps platform) to improve developer experience.

• Support service migrations to KickOff, partnering with product teams.

• Maintain and optimize KickOff on AWS EKS.

• Manage our on-premises Kubernetes clusters running ML training workloads.

• Establish monitoring, alerting, and observability using LGTM.

• Debug distributed systems spanning multiple environments.

• Create documentation and tooling that makes infrastructure approachable

As the platform matures, you'll have opportunities to shape multi-cluster architecture, GPU workload scheduling, disaster recovery strategy, and cloud provider independence.

What You Could Bring

We're looking for someone with 3-5 years running production infrastructure, including:

• Production Kubernetes: You've operated K8s in production and understand the operational reality, not just tutorials.

• Platform-as-product mindset: You've built internal tooling that real teams use, gathered feedback, and measured impact on productivity.

• Infrastructure as Code: Strong Terraform, Crossplane, or similar experience.

• Observability: You've implemented monitoring and alerting that helps teams operate confidently.

• Security awareness: You know how to embed security into platform design without slowing teams down.

• Problem-solving: You debug complex distributed systems and design practical solutions.

• Collaboration: You work through discussion and feedback, share context effectively.

Nice to have: GitOps tools (Flux, ArgoCD), Cilium, multi-cloud architecture, on-prem K8s experience.

How We Work

You’ll join a Copenhagen-based platform team of 5 engineers with shared ownership of KickOff and our on-prem Kubernetes clusters. We work closely together day to day through pairing, code reviews, and a rotating ownership model for operational responsibilities and platform improvements.

You’ll collaborate regularly with the Processing Platform team on workload needs, reliability, and developer experience, and you’ll use feedback from product and engineering teams to shape platform priorities and improve how teams build and ship on KickOff.

We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.
